parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description: The type of the business. Valid values: FREEZE: the frozen business of the account. TRUSTEESHIP: the hosted business of the account.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The account status that you want to set. Valid values: Freeze: The account is frozen. Thaw: The account is unfrozen. Trusteeship: The account is hosted. TrusteeshipCancel: The account is not hosted.

parameters.name: StopMode
parameters.description:
停机模式
取值：
    0：普通停机
    1：立即停机

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi set-reseller-user-status --status Freeze --business-type FREEZE --stop-mode 0 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi SetResellerUserStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status Freeze --BusinessType FREEZE --StopMode 0
